title: Everyday identities — 2026-09-20

source.rationale: A thoughtful paper-goods name with a flowing rhythm of broad round bowls and soft bracketed serifs. Set exactly OFFCUT in one line; the O and C are generous oval forms, the F pair has shortened upper arms to keep open gaps, U has a deep curved basin, T has a softly flared top. Medium weight and low-to-moderate stroke contrast; serif feet curve into stems. One small identifying choice is the soft inward curl of the C terminal. Optical kerning, not rigid equal spacing. All six letters stay separate and clearly readable. No added symbol. Overall horizontal lettering occupies 78% of the canvas width, calm central placement.
source.preserve: Rounded O/C bowls and the rhythm of two F letters.
source.change: Overdecorated terminals or heavy uppercase could bring back the rejected industrial feel.
source.observation: See visual-review.json for image observations, distinct from the design specification.

source.rationale: Exactly OFFCUT in one line as an approachable paper-play wordmark. Draw compact, soft, slightly irregular uppercase letters with voluptuous curves and distinctly open white counters. The O is slightly tipped left, F letters are round-ended with generous notches, C is broad and open, the U sits a little lower as a bowl, the T opens its arms. Give the name a gentle rising-and-falling rhythm without touching or losing the baseline reading. Flat solid color and an edited hand-cut-paper feel without jagged cut edges or texture. The whole name fills 80% of the width at center. No separate symbol or confetti.
source.preserve: Open O/C/U counters and gently bouncing single-line lettering.
source.change: Inflation or over-tight spacing can erase F/F and C/U distinctions.

source.rationale: Exactly LUMA, four custom rounded uppercase letters with a warm, confidently drawn 1970s editorial spirit. Use moderately wide letter bodies and a shared smooth flared terminal family. L ends in a gentle upward curl, U has a deep broad bowl, M has two generous rounded shoulders with an open central notch, A has an arched outside and one unmistakable large interior counter and crossbar. Keep the letter skeletons familiar while the soft flared rhythm is distinctive. Each letter is one flat color. Quietly varied widths and carefully balanced white intervals, all on a calm baseline. Center the horizontal word at 78% canvas width. No supporting icon.
source.preserve: Flared soft feet and open U/M/A spaces.
source.change: A can lose its counter or M can look like an n if over-rounded.
source.observation: See visual-review.json for image observations, distinct from the design specification.

source.rationale: Exactly two capital L letters as a compact, elegant, friendly LL ligature for a textile workshop. Each L has a tall open loop at its top and a soft sweeping foot at the bottom. Place the second slightly lower to the right; let the two broad ribbon-like strokes meet in one carefully designed under-over crossing with a clean white separation at that crossing. Both L letter paths must remain readable, with large open loops and no more than one crossing. Moderately thick gently varying stroke widths; no hairlines. The outside silhouette is rounded, airy and almost heart-warm, without drawing a heart symbol. Mark occupies roughly 62% width and 65% height at center. Flat monochrome ink, no 3D ribbon shading. Absolutely no square-ended L blocks, nested right-angle brackets, construction beams or angular monogram.
source.preserve: Two open upper loops and the swept double foot.
source.change: An over-complex crossing could look like a knot rather than LL.
source.observation: See visual-review.json for image observations, distinct from the design specification.

source.rationale: A small serene symbol of one softly cupped vessel enclosing a low, smooth pool-shaped opening, seen as a broad organic bowl silhouette rather than a literal outlined teacup. source.rationale: A friendly oval bakery emblem whose outer border has six large, shallow, softly scalloped lobes, like the edge of a paper pastry doily but very simplified. A single solid strawberry-red ink; border and letters have related weights and ample gap. Emblem fills about 66% width, all type readable. source.rationale: An original affectionate cat mascot centered above exactly MISO. A broad gently pear-shaped face, small rounded triangular ears, one sleepy half-closed eye and one simple upright oval eye, tiny curved mouth; distinctive asymmetry comes from a soft cheek rising on one side. The face is an apricot filled silhouette, eye and mouth marks in deep plum, no whiskers or fine fur. Underneath, MISO in custom plump but open rounded uppercase letters; the M shoulders and O share the cheek curvature. Keep the eyes simple and calm rather than cartoon-excited. Cat and name have a generous clear gap. Entire lockup centered at 57% width and 68% height. No props, paws, ribbons, badges or famous mascot resemblance.

source.rationale: Exactly NL as two separate readable uppercase initials for a warm boutique guesthouse. Draw broad elegant N and L in a soft editorial serif with curved bracketed serifs and medium stroke contrast. N has softly flaring stems and a rounded meeting at its diagonal; L has a gently cupped foot that sweeps slightly upward at the end, echoing a quiet upholstered seat. Letters sit next to each other on the same baseline, do not overlap or share strokes. A carefully balanced open interval separates the N diagonal from the L stem. Rich muted aubergine flat ink. Centered compact two-letter signature, 58% canvas width. No squared monoliths, stencil cuts, mountains, compass, arrow, shield or hotel crest.

source.rationale: Exactly the two Korean syllables 물결 as a quiet custom lettering-only wordmark. Preserve every normal consonant and vowel component: 물 = ㅁ + ㅜ + ㄹ, 결 = ㄱ + ㅕ + ㄹ. Especially keep the downward stem of ㅜ and the two left-facing short strokes of ㅕ. Use broad rounded brush-like strokes with controlled slight variation, subtly rising horizontal strokes, soft but clear corners, generous open internal spaces. The two complete syllable blocks have equal visual weight and a clear inter-syllable gap. A gentle wave is expressed only through the baseline and terminal rhythm, never by replacing a letter. Blue single ink, 64% width centered. No separate wave, underline, landscape or watery gradients.
source.preserve: Full 물/결 structure and calm horizontal rhythm.
source.change: ㄹ terminals and ㅕ strokes can merge if the rhythm is over-stylized.
source.observation: See visual-review.json for image observations, distinct from the design specification.

source.rationale: One deliberately drawn unfurling fern as a compact organic pictorial mark. A gently S-curved thick stem rises into a broad inward curl, with three generous asymmetrical paddle-shaped fronds on alternating sides. The lower left frond cups upward, the middle right frond reaches wide, the upper frond is smaller; this rhythm rather than extra botanical detail is the identity. All connected to a coherent central gesture, no spindly branches. Deeply open white gaps between fronds and a round open eye inside the top curl. Flat moss-green silhouette, soft blunt tips and calm asymmetry. Centered 55% width, 65% height. No leaf veins, pot, circle, medical cross, letter or text.
source.preserve: Top curl and three alternating broad fronds.
source.change: Botanical category familiarity is intentional; does not establish uniqueness.

source.rationale: A warm personal-journaling identity: a compact symbol of two soft paper-tab shapes sharing a gentle curved inner gap sits above the exact words NOVA NOTES. Symbol about one third the word width, with an airy clear gap above the two-line lettering. Overall compact vertical lockup 57% width and 67% height. No star, sparkle, speed line, diagonal cuts, tilted athletic type or extra slogan.

source.rationale: One warm milk bun as a deliberately sculpted app icon for a home-baking journal. source.rationale: One compact paper-fan signature for a collage app, made from exactly three large flat paper-petal pieces growing from a common low base. Left pink piece tilts left and is medium height; center golden-orange piece stands tallest; right cobalt piece tilts right and is shorter and wider. Let them overlap only at the broad common base, with clean purposeful junctions; no thin white channel or bent tubular stroke. The overall silhouette is an asymmetric fan, not a flower with a stem, a hand, a star or scattered confetti. Color has a clear role on each piece and never becomes random fragmented patchwork. Flat crisp fills with no texture, shading or translucent effects. Entire mark fills72% width and64% height. A pale lemon background fills the square edge-to-edge; no inner rounded tile or frame.
